title: Ireland's all-time top scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for the Republic of Ireland in full internationals, to the end of the 2026 World Cup.

notes.Gerry Daly: Gerry Daly is joint 11th with 13, just outside.
notes.Jimmy Dunne: Jimmy Dunne is joint 11th with 13, just outside.
notes.Troy Parrott: Troy Parrott had 11 at the end of the 2026 World Cup; his goals since then don't count here.

checks: Wikipedia's national team article as it stood on 16 July 2026 (updated after Ireland's last match before the cut-off, Ireland v Canada on 5 June 2026), RSSSF (last match included 5 June 2026) and Wikipedia's list of internationals agree on every figure. Transfermarkt swaps Stapleton and Aldridge (19 and 20) but has the same ten; its match data gives Parrott 11 at the cut-off (15 now).
